home.heroLead: Hand-brewed single-origin Nepali coffee, fresh pastries every morning, and a quiet seat by the lake.

about.headline: Six years of slow coffee on Lakeside
story: Kettle & Crow started with one kettle, one grinder and a counter facing the lake. Six years later we still brew every cup by hand, because it is the best way we know to taste what Nepali coffee can do.
We bake our own pastries each morning and roast beans in small batches, so what you take home tastes like what you had at the counter.
about.mission: Serve Nepali coffee the way it deserves to be brewed: carefully, one cup at a time.
about.values: Take our time with every cup, buy from Nepali growers, and keep the room calm enough to sit for an hour.
about.experience: Six years of brewing and baking on Lakeside, Pokhara.

services.intro: Come in for a cup, take beans home, or book the upstairs room.

items.name: Hand-brewed coffee
items.summary: Pour-over, espresso and cold brew from single-origin Nepali beans.
items.details: Choose a brew method at the counter and we will talk you through the beans on offer that week. Every cup is made to order, so expect a few minutes and a better coffee.

items.name: Beans to take home
items.summary: Freshly roasted bags, ground to order for your brewer.
items.details: Tell us how you brew at home, from French press to espresso, and we will grind to match. Whole beans keep longest, so ask for them if you buy in bulk.

items.name: Private bookings
items.summary: The upstairs room for meetings, small parties and tastings.
items.details: The upstairs room seats small groups with a view of the lake. Book it for a meeting, a birthday or a guided coffee tasting, and we will bring the coffee and pastries up.

Every piece is made in small runs, so colours change with each batch from the loom. When a design sells out, it may not come back in the same pattern.
